LESSON: CUBES AND CUBE ROOTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.2: Cubes and Cube Roots
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cubes and Cube Roots, part of Numbers in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we work out the cubes of numbers? 2. How do we work out the cube roots of numbers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. work out cubes of numbers by multiplication in real-life situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. determine cubes of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. determine cube roots of numbers by factor method in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. determine cube roots of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. determine cube and cube roots of numbers using a calculator,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. apply cubes and cube roots in real-life situations.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cubes and Cube Roots in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. work out cubes of numbers by multiplication in real-life situations,

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. determine cubes of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. determine cube roots of numbers by factor method in different situations,

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. determine cube roots of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. determine cube and cube roots of numbers using a calculator,

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

F. apply cubes and cube roots in real-life situations.

   Cubes and Cube Roots helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

G. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use stacks of cubes to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots,

2. demonstrate stacking of cubes,

3. discuss the volume of a cube, determine both the cube and cube root, and relate the two,

4. read the cube of numbers from mathematical tables and relate it to cube roots,

5. use calculators to work out cube and cube roots of numbers. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use stacks of cubes to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots,
2. demonstrate stacking of cubes,
3. discuss the volume of a cube, determine both the cube and cube root, and relate the two,
4. read the cube of numbers from mathematical tables and relate it to cube roots,
5. use calculators to work out cube and cube roots of numbers. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cubes and Cube Roots together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: speaking and listening as the learner works with peers to use stacks of cubes to

demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots.

• Imagination and Creativity - open-mindedness and creativity: as the learner determines both the cube and cube root and

relates the two.

Values:
Respect: as the learner appreciates each other’s contribution in the discussions on the volume of cubes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental Awareness: the learner uses stacks of cubes to demonstrate the concept of cube and cube roots, related to

objects in the environment.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of volume to derived quantities in integrated science.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. work out cubes of numbers by multiplication in real-life situations,
2. determine cubes of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,
3. determine cube roots of numbers by factor method in different situations,
4. determine cube roots of numbers from mathematical tables in different situations,
5. determine cube and cube roots of numbers using a calculator,
6. apply cubes and cube roots in real-life situations.
